lines.2: 「So... it's true that Iron-senpai and Tsushima are living together.」
lines.3: 「It's irritating, but they're relatives, so there's nothing to be done about it.」
lines.4: 「But Iron-senpai could have refused to live with him, couldn't she?」
lines.5: 「She used to commute from Shibamata in Tokyo.」
lines.6: 「I see. If you think about the commute and everything, I guess it makes sense.」
lines.7: 「...Ah! No! I still can't accept it!」
lines.8: 「I'm going to ask Iron-senpai after school.」
lines.9: 「Your devotion to Iron-senpai is something else.」
lines.10: 「Of course. I'm completely devoted to her. I don't pull unfaithful stunts like you, chasing both the Princess and senpai.」
lines.11: 「Iron-senpai is the very model of a maiden!」
lines.12: 「That's exactly why I want to know why she favors Tsushima.」
